_meta.purpose: Single primary-basket overrides for Baker (Atreides) holdings on the trigger_analysis.xlsx context sheets. Each held ticker maps to exactly ONE basket. Resolution order: primary_basket[ticker] -> primary_basket_by_cusip[cusip] -> ai_basket_reclassification.json bucket -> position theme -> 'Unassigned'.
_meta.rationale: For tickers in several thesis-level baskets in theme_baskets_v3.json, this picks the primary by Baker's highest-conviction / most-natural categorization. Other memberships appear in the 'also_in' note column, not as duplicate rows. by_cusip handles positions that file with an unresolved (null) ticker.
_meta.editable: Change any value to re-home a ticker; add a ticker or cusip to override.
